3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The thump of airplane wheels on asphalt jolted me from my sleep.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I was seated in the commercial jet we'd chartered for our royal visit to Thornbough. It had been a long, bumpy ride.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: As we descended the airplane stairs onto the tarmac, a horn quartet played a jubilant fanfare. Photographers in a cordoned-off press area eagerly began snapping pictures.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: A red carpet stretched from the plane to a waiting motorcade. Next to a pair of limousines, Beatrice Livingston and the Rumburg royal family waited to greet us.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: The Queen regarded me politely, but with some remove. She held out her hand.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: The queen's eyes brimmed with sympathy as I approached. She pulled me into an embrace.
17.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Friendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Allied"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: The queen had a compassionate look in her eyes as I approached. We exchanged cheek kisses.
18.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Friendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Allied"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

19.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
19.text: "My dear, dear brother-in-law. You've gotten yourself into quite the mess, haven't you?"

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "Nothing Rumburg can't get me out of."

21.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
21.text: "My dear brother-in-law. What a pleasure it is to finally host you in Thornbourgh."

22.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
22.text: "Romus, Your Majesty. You've gotten yourself into quite the mess."

23.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
23.text: "Romus, Your Majesty. It has been some time."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "Nonsense. Everything in Pales is perfectly under control."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "It's almost a good thing your sister didn't live to see these times."

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: She stepped back with a scandalized look on her face.

33.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
33.text: "It will only be under control once you have won."
33.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false) == false

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "I'm looking forward to your legendary Rumburgian hospitality."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "Nothing Rumburg can't get me out of."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "Nonsense. Everything in Pales is perfectly under control."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "It's almost a good thing your sister didn't live to see these times. Almost."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "It's not a mess. It's a catastrophe."

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: She stepped back with a horrified look on her face.

44.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
44.text: "I was speaking euphemistically. It's the Rumburgian way."

46.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
46.text: "I was not only speaking about Pales."

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "Indeed, Your Excellency. How have you been?"

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Really? I feel like I just saw you."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "An eternity, and yet no time at all."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "I know we've drifted apart over the past years, but it's a pleasure to be here."

60.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
60.text: "I have been better. As have you."

61.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
61.text: "A pity she could not be here."

65.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
65.text: "How lovely. I'm just dying to hear about her time in the Grand Duchy."

66.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
66.text: "How lovely. A pity she could not be here."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "We'll have to make this a quick visit, I'm afraid. Turbulent times back home."

68.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
68.text: "You will not be disappointed. Either of you."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false

71.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
71.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false

72.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
72.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false) == false

74.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
74.text: "Really? From where I'm sitting, your reign looks smooth as silk."
74.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false) == false

75.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
75.text: "If that was a joke, it's not very amusing."

76.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
76.text: "Surely you are being facetious. So much has changed."

81.speaker: Narrator
81.text: I had just finished getting dressed when Lucita entered the compartment. She was outfitted in full military regalia.
81.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: I was in the bedroom of my royal jet, {RiziaDLCText.RoyalJet}. It had been a long but smooth flight to Thornbourgh.

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: I had just finished getting dressed when I heard a knock on the door to my compartment.
89.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false)

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: I had just finished getting dressed when I heard a knock on the door to my compartment.

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "How dare you barge in on me like that? I could've been naked."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "You can't see it, but I'm saluting you right now."

108.speaker: Lucita Azaro
108.text: "It's been more than a decade. You are in-laws no longer."

111.speaker: Lucita Azaro
111.text: "Apologies, Your Majesty. Next time I'll barge in earlier."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "I have always tried my hardest to be a decent man and a decent king."

114.speaker: Narrator
114.text: She sat next to me on the bed and squeezed my hand.

115.speaker: Lucita Azaro
115.text: "I hope the Queen's in a good mood. Rumburg's support could really turn the tide against Pales."

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: Lucita was in the seat next to mine. On seeing I was awake, she squeezed my hand surreptitiously.
125.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)

132.speaker: Narrator
132.text: Lucita was in the seat next to mine. On seeing I was awake, she smiled.
132.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false)

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: Laurento was in the seat next to mine. On seeing I was awake, he smiled.

134.speaker: Lucita Azaro
134.text: "Good morning, Your Majesty. I'm glad you were able to get some rest."

135.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
135.text: "Good morning, Your Majesty. I'm glad you were able to get some rest."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Are you joking? I can hardly sleep in my own bed, let alone on an airplane."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "I always sleep well on airplanes. No phone calls or letters, no responsibilities except to get from point A to point B."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "It wasn't easy. I've been nervous about today's meeting."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "I was having the most marvelous dream. I think you were involved."

144.speaker: Lucita Azaro
144.text: "How fascinating. I suggest we unpack its meaning in private later."

148.speaker: Lucita Azaro
148.text: "What an honor, Your Majesty. I assume I was clothed."

149.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
149.text: "Ah. Your father was the same way. Restless till the end."

153.speaker: Lucita Azaro
153.text: "Sorry to hear. I've trained myself to be able to sleep on any surface."

157.speaker: Lucita Azaro
157.text: "Your military training didn't take, then. They taught me to be able to sleep anywhere."

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: She adjusted the pins over her breast pocket.

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: He pulled a tin of wax out of his pocket and dabbed some onto the ends of his moustache.

169.speaker: Lucita Azaro
169.text: "And plan for what will happen once we land."

170.speaker: Lucita Azaro
170.text: "Just making sure you're ready for our meeting with your sister-in-law."

171.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
171.text: "Just making sure you're ready for our meeting with your sister-in-law."

172.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
172.text: "Rumburg's foreign ministers have hinted that the Queen is quite dissatisfied with our recent actions."

176.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
176.text: "With all the foreign turmoil happening lately, it is comforting to know that Queen Beatrice is still on our side."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "I doubt it. I've done nothing but alienate Rumburg since my coronation."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "She had better be. I've been bending over backwards for Rumburg since my coronation."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "She's family. Family members support each other, no matter what."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "I'm sure she wants to get Vina out of there as I do."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "This visit is just a courtesy. We're perfectly capable of defeating Pales on our own."

192.speaker: Lucita Azaro
192.text: "As long as ATO doesn't get involved."

195.speaker: Lucita Azaro
195.text: "Beatrice's only real family in Rizia is Vina. But she does seem to be fond of the Princess."

196.speaker: Lucita Azaro
196.text: "You always have your family ties to fall back on. If she still considers herself family."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "I'm not surprised. I've done nothing but alienate Rumburg since my coronation."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "She had better be. I've been bending over backwards for Rumburg since my coronation."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "She's family. Family members support each other, no matter what."

200.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
200.text: "Yes, I have no doubt that Her Excellency still harbors warm feelings towards you."

201.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
201.text: "You always have your family ties to fall back on. Her Excellency was always fond of Princess Vina."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Is that so? What did I do?"

204.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
204.text: "I am sure Her Excellency is eager to tell you in person."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Whatever that's worth. Rumburg hasn't been looking great internationally."

206.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
206.text: "It is still a most powerful nation. And by far a more useful friend than enemy."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "If you say so. I've been questioning the value of our so-called alliance."

208.speaker: Lucita Azaro
208.text: "It's still a very powerful country. By far a better friend than enemy."

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: The plane's door slid open. An aide informed us that everything had been cleared for our arrival.

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: Thornbourgh Airport, one of the biggest transportation hubs in Merkopa, had been completely emptied of passengers for our visit.

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: She abruptly turned and regarded Lucita, who was standing behind me.

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: She abruptly turned and regarded Laurento, who was standing behind me.

217.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
217.text: "Mr. Esquibel. His Majesty is lucky to have retained the services of a fine statesman like yourself."

219.speaker: Narrator
219.text: With a flourish, he knelt and kissed Beatrice's hand. She blushed slightly.

221.speaker: Lucita Azaro
221.text: "A pleasure to finally meet you, Your Excellency. I hope you've only heard good things."

225.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
225.text: "Why, of course. A noblewoman *and* a decorated military officer? You're a credit to our sex."

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: Her eyes traveled from Lucita to myself and back. She smiled insincerely.

228.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
228.text: "Let's not delay. We have a full program of events planned at the Emerald Palace."

229.speaker: Narrator
229.text: She cursorily introduced Lucita to King Consort Boris and Prince Bradley. I exchanged greetings with the two men.

230.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
230.text: "Oh. You remember King Consort Boris and Prince Bradley."

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: Laurento and I exchanged cursory greetings with the two men.

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: A chauffeur opened their limousine door, and they stepped in. Queen Beatrice, Lucita and I were escorted over to a second car.

233.speaker: Narrator
233.text: A chauffeur opened their limousine door, and they stepped in. Queen Beatrice, Laurento and I were escorted over to a second car.

234.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
234.text: "I hope you two don't mind the company. We have so much to catch up on, I thought we should start right away."

235.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
235.text: "I hope you two don't mind the company. We have so much to catch up on, I thought we should start right away."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "It would be an honor to ride with you."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Two monarchs in one car. I hope there aren't any assassins about."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "Good thinking. You never know who's listening in at the palace."

242.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
242.text: "Let's not delay. We have a full program of events planned at the Emerald Palace."

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "Must we? I was looking forward to riding in silence."

244.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
244.text: "Don't be silly. Where do you think we are, Wehlen?"

246.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
246.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false

247.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
247.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false) == false

248.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
248.text: "I was not only speaking about Pales."
248.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_FrameForWehlenBombing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == false

250.speaker: Narrator
250.text: She gave me a stern look.

253.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
253.text: "I assure you our security is second to none. But of course, one can never be too careful."

254.speaker: Narrator
254.text: We got into the car and sat facing each other on leather banquettes. The engine thrummed to life, and we began moving.

255.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
255.text: "Frankly, given the state of things between our kingdoms, I ought to leave you high and dry."

262.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
262.text: "Naturally, I would love to have a hand in the surrender of that self-styled Duke Reinhart."

263.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
263.text: "Need I remind you of your kingdom's broken energy promises?"

264.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
264.text: "What did you expect would happen when you undermined Rumburg by helping Wehlen in its senseless campaign against the Bluds?"
264.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false)

265.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
265.text: "What were you thinking when you took advantage of our embargo on Wehzek oil to begin importing it yourself?"
265.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false)

271.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
271.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

275.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
275.text: "But we share a common goal. The rescue of dear Princess Vina from her Palesian captors."

276.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
276.text: "For the sake of my niece, I will forgive any number of transgressions on Rizia's part."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "Thank you, Your Excellency. That means a lot to me."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "Really? You care about Vina that much?"

280.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
280.text: "Do you think I'm a monster, Your Majesty? She is my flesh and blood."

281.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
281.text: "I am not doing this for you."

282.speaker: Narrator
282.text: She shot me an ominous glance.

283.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
283.text: "We will get into that later. If we have time."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "So you would not offer your aid if Vina's life weren't on the line. How disappointing."

285.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
285.text: "There is a limit to Rumburg's generosity. I feel Rizia has been testing it of late."

286.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
286.text: "I should say so. I needn't remind you of the superiority of Rumburg's military technology."

290.speaker: Lucita Azaro
290.text: "Of course our operations in Pales are fully concentrated on the rescue of Princess Vina. Any support you can offer will surely increase our chances of success."

291.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
291.text: "The capture of the Aureus gas field would, of course, be a lovely bonus."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "This war is not about resources. It's about our kingdom's sovereignty."

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "You do know that Rumburg is no longer our only energy partner."

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "It would, wouldn't it? But let's not get too far ahead of ourselves."

297.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
297.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_ExportGas"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_MorellaPipeline_Project"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Project"] == true) == false

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "The capture of the gas field is less important to me than the eradication of Western influence."

299.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
299.text: "Yes, yes. We will defend that sovereignty together."

303.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
303.text: "That as well. The members of ATO should mind their own nations."

304.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
304.text: "Yes, yes. There is more than enough gas in that field to share."

305.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
305.text: "Agreed. We have a war to win first."

307.speaker: Lucita Azaro
307.text: "Our troops in Pales are fully concentrated on winning the war without harming the integrity of the gas field. Any support you can offer will surely increase their chances of success."

308.speaker: Lucita Azaro
308.text: "Actually, Your Excellency, the capabilities of the Rizian military have grown by leaps and bounds since the beginning of King Romus' reign."

312.speaker: Lucita Azaro
312.text: "I cannot argue with that, Your Excellency. Our homegrown military industry is in its infancy compared to yours."

313.speaker: Lucita Azaro
313.text: "But yes, our industry is still in its infancy compared to yours."

315.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
315.text: "We shall prepare a sizeable shipment of our very finest equipment. KA-74s, grenades, body armor... all will be at your disposal."

317.speaker: Player_Romus
317.text: "I have a few more specialized requests."

319.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
319.text: "It is the least I can do."

323.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
323.text: "I expect you to use it responsibly."

327.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
327.text: "And the safe and sound return of my dear niece, needless to say."

330.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
330.text: "What else do you need to win the war?"
330.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "We could use more tanks. Our men on the ground are moving around unprotected."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Say, do your scientists happen to be developing nuclear weapons? I'd love one or two of those."

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Is there anything experimental you're working on? Something the enemy won't expect at all?"

335.speaker: Player_Romus
335.text: "We need trucks. All that equipment is no good if we can't transport it."

336.speaker: Narrator
336.text: She put a hand to her necklace.

337.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
337.text: "Oh, my. Wherever did you get that idea?"

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: A confidential glint appeared in her eye.

340.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
340.text: "Our laboratories have been working on a powerful new nerve agent. A few milligrams are powerful enough to kill a rat from 50 meters away."

341.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
341.text: "It has not yet been tested on humans. But we're happy to let Rizia do the honors."

342.speaker: Player_Romus
342.text: "Oh, God. No, we don't want any part in that."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "The Palesians hardly qualify as human. But yes, we'll take it."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "Sounds extreme. But, well, these are extreme times."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "I am loathe to use chemical weapons, but a stockpile might come in handy in case of emergency."

349.speaker: Narrator
349.text: Lucita recoiled in horror. She shook her head slightly.

352.speaker: Narrator
352.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true

358.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
358.text: "You'll have to let me know whether it works. We see its promise in expediting future conflicts."

360.speaker: Lucita Azaro
360.text: "Are you telling me that Rumburg is not currently engaged in any nuclear research programs?"

361.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
361.text: "Is this an interrogation, Duchess Azaro? I will warn you not to take Rumburg's largesse for granted."

362.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
362.text: "Of course it should be reserved for only the most dire of circumstances. Lord willing, you will not need it at all."

365.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
365.text: "Now. Please let me know if you have any serious requests."

366.speaker: Narrator
366.text: I saw Lucita nod in approval.

367.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
367.text: "A most reasonable request. Consider it granted."

371.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
371.text: "My dear, if you want more, all you have to do is ask."

373.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
373.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true

374.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
374.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

375.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
375.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true

378.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
378.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false

379.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
379.text: "I simply cannot abide by the terms of the agreement you made with Wehlen."

380.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
380.text: "Rumburg has been working hard to assist the Bludish Freedom Front in their struggle for liberation. It does us no good for you to be aiding in their oppression."

381.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
381.text: "Rizia's ties to Sordland irk me to no end."
381.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false

384.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
384.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

385.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
385.text: "And furthermore, Rizia's continued ties to Sordland irk me to no end."

386.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
386.text: "Do you understand what I want from you, Your Majesty?"

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "Your Excellency, I assure you our partnership with Rumburg is more valuable to us than our foreign connections."

388.speaker: Player_Romus
388.text: "No, I'm not sure that I do."

389.speaker: Player_Romus
389.text: "My dealings with other foreign leaders are not any of Rumburg's business. I won't renege on any of my agreements, even in exchange for more military assistance."

390.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
390.text: "Then I kindly ask you to prove it."

395.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
395.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)

396.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
396.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)) == false

397.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
397.text: "Break at least one of your agreements with Wehlen or Sordland, and I will consider offering you additional assistance."
397.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)

398.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
398.text: "Promise to leave the Bluds alone, and I will consider offering you additional assistance."
398.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)

401.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
401.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false

402.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
402.text: "Stop associating with the Sords, and I will consider offering you additional assistance."
402.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false)

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "So you won't offer us more even if it will help Princess Vina?"

408.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
408.text: "If *you* care deeply about rescuing your daughter, you will do me this basic courtesy."

409.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
409.text: "I do have one rather unconventional suggestion."
409.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Rumburg_SellPortOfMonqiz"] == true) == false)

410.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
410.text: "You could sell us your Port of Monqiz."

411.speaker: Lucita Azaro
411.text: "His Majesty is absolutely right. Granting any foreign country control over Monqiz would be a major security risk."

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "We'll sell you our largest port over my dead body."

413.speaker: Player_Romus
413.text: "Sure, why not? I don't see the harm in it."

414.speaker: Lucita Azaro
414.text: "What? Your Majesty, Monqiz is our most strategically vital shipping hub."

415.speaker: Player_Romus
415.text: "Granting your kingdom a foothold in the southern Antacean. I see."

416.speaker: Lucita Azaro
416.text: "Convenient for Rumburg. But a gigantic security risk for us."

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "I have some concerns about that proposal. To put it mildly."

418.speaker: Lucita Azaro
418.text: "As you should, Your Majesty. We can ill afford to lose another part of Rizia."

420.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
420.text: "Look at how shabby the port has become. With our technology, we can get it into tip-top shape in an instant."

424.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
424.text: "Your efforts to modernize the port have been admirable, but with our technology, we can maximize its efficiency even further."

425.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
425.text: "But Rumburg is not just any foreign country, are we?"

426.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
426.text: "Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grace. I foresee advantages for both of us."

427.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
427.text: "You wouldn't be losing Monqiz. You'd be sharing it."

428.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
428.text: "As you're shipping us a sizeable amount of energy through Monqiz, it's only logical to give us a say in how that shipping is run."

432.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
432.text: "And giving Rumburg a say in how shipping is run would only be logical should you begin sending us gas from the Aureus field."

433.speaker: Player_Romus
433.text: "What you're saying makes sense. But I still have reservations."

434.speaker: Player_Romus
434.text: "Such a cooperation would truly cement the alliance between our monarchies."

435.speaker: Player_Romus
435.text: "If we did this for you, we'd never owe you anything again."

436.speaker: Player_Romus
436.text: "We are trying to become less dependent on Rumburg. This will accomplish the opposite."

440.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
440.text: "Less dependent on everything but our military aid, you mean."

444.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
444.text: "Let's not beat around the bush. You have come here to ask for help in the war against Pales."

445.speaker: Player_Romus
445.text: "You are correct, Your Excellency. Will Rumburg come to our aid?"

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "That'd be convenient for you, wouldn't it? But no, Rizia is well on its way to defeating Pales on its own."

451.speaker: Lucita Azaro
451.text: "We have captured the cities of Arces and Ziqes. Victory is within our grasp."

455.speaker: Narrator
455.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true)

456.speaker: Lucita Azaro
456.text: "We have captured the city of Arces. Victory is within our grasp."

457.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
457.text: "I do not doubt your capabilities, Your Grace. But I cannot rest easily until I have done everything I can to rescue dear Princess Vina from her Palesian captors."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "Thank you, Your Excellency. Your affection for Vina is touching."

469.speaker: Narrator
469.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true)

473.speaker: Lucita Azaro
473.text: "We have captured the city of Ziqes. Victory is within our grasp."

474.speaker: Narrator
474.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Arces"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Ziqes"] == true) == false)

475.speaker: Lucita Azaro
475.text: "I'm afraid His Majesty does not have an accurate picture of the situation. We are failing on all fronts at the moment."

476.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
476.text: "Then you truly have no need for military aid from us?"

480.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
480.text: "And let's not forget that our dear Princess Vina is still a captive of the Palesians."

481.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
481.text: "I cannot rest easily until I have done everything I can to secure her safe return."

484.speaker: Player_Romus
484.text: "I do not need Rumburg or anyone's help. The Lord has ordained that we shall win this fight."

492.speaker: Lucita Azaro
492.text: "I believe our success has less to do with the Lord and more with the renewed strength of the Rizian military. But yes, we are doing well."

498.speaker: Lucita Azaro
498.text: "That's an exaggeration, Your Excellency. But we would appreciate any assistance we can get from Rumburg."

500.speaker: Lucita Azaro
500.text: "That's unfortunately not an exaggeration, Your Excellency. We are failing on all fronts."

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "No. Of course I will let you know if the situation changes."

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "Yes, fine. Perhaps we do require Rumburg's assistance after all."

506.speaker: Player_Romus
506.text: "A temporary setback. I am certain we will recover."

507.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
507.text: "If you are absolutely certain, then I will not press the matter."

509.speaker: Narrator
509.text: She leaned back on the banquette.

510.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
510.text: "I am sorry His Majesty diverted your attention from the war to come see me, Duchess Azaro."

514.speaker: Lucita Azaro
514.text: "No apology needed. It has been my pleasure to accompany His Majesty here."

515.speaker: Lucita Azaro
515.text: "My attention is always on the war, Your Excellency. No matter where I am."

516.speaker: Narrator
516.text: A sour look appeared on Beatrice's face.

518.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
518.text: "A true professional. Once you've defeated Pales, you simply must host a guest training session with Rumburg's troops."

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "Absolutely not. I am a king of my word, and I stick to my agreements."

525.speaker: Player_Romus
525.text: "I will not. The heretic Golcondists do not deserve my mercy."

527.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
527.text: "Circumstances change, Your Majesty. A wise monarch is flexible."

529.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
529.text: "No need for hyperbole. But it would be quite the grand gesture."

531.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
531.text: "Understandable. But time is of the essence in war."

533.speaker: Lucita Azaro
533.text: "We do not need to resort to desperate measures to win the war, Your Majesty. We should not relinquish control of a critical asset for the sake of some extra artillery."

537.speaker: Lucita Azaro
537.text: "I admit winning the war may require drastic measures. But relinquishing control of this critical asset will leave us vulnerable in the future."

538.speaker: Player_Romus
538.text: "We will not sell Monqiz, nor make any other concessions. We will win with the equipment we have."

542.speaker: Player_Romus
542.text: "I won't sell the port, Your Excellency. But I am willing to break certain diplomatic ties, as you suggested earlier."

543.speaker: Player_Romus
543.text: "I know it's a risk, but victory will be worth it. We will sell the port, Your Excellency." [+2 Budget, +2 Budget Per Turn]

545.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
545.text: "Brilliant. This will be our kingdoms' most fruitful collaboration yet."

547.speaker: Narrator
547.text: Lucita tried hard to hide her dismay.

551.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
551.text: "Very well. May Dast be with you and your troops."

552.speaker: Player_Romus
552.text: "All right. Here's what I am willing to do."

553.speaker: Player_Romus
553.text: "Is there nothing else our kingdom can do for you instead?"

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "I will allow the Bludish people into Rizia once more."

572.speaker: Player_Romus
572.text: "I will cease Rizia's participation in Operation Bear Trap."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "I will end Rizia's trade deal with Sordland."

574.speaker: Player_Romus
574.text: "I will nationalize the Sordish resort in Valenqiris."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "I will break off the bonds Rizia purchased from Sordland."

576.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
576.text: "I understand the need to remain invested in Gasom. But outside of that, I don't see why you should be doing the Sords any favors."

582.speaker: Narrator
582.text: The Queen nodded with some satisfaction.

584.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
584.text: "Now. How else can I help your military?"

588.speaker: Lucita Azaro
588.text: "I sincerely hope your technology lives up to its reputation."

589.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
589.text: "Of course it will, Your Grace. Now, what do you need?"

596.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
596.text: "My generosity stops there, I am afraid."

598.speaker: Lucita Azaro
598.text: "That's extremely helpful, Your Excellency. Thank you."

599.speaker: Player_Romus
599.text: "I understand. You're doing enough for us."

600.speaker: Player_Romus
600.text: "But I wasn't finished with my requests. Can Rizia sweeten the deal somehow?"
600.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_NerveGas"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_Trucks"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_Manpower"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_Tanks"] == false

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "We need manpower. Can you send soldiers?"

602.speaker: Narrator
602.text: Beatrics closed her eyes and shook her head.

603.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
603.text: "You know I wish I could. But getting directly involved in Rizia's conflict would open up all sorts of cans of worms."

605.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
605.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true

606.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
606.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false

607.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
607.text: "However... I can take advantage of my kingdom's contacts within the Bludish Freedom Front."
607.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false

608.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
608.text: "You must already have heard tales of the Bluds' fighting prowess. Despite their... unconventional habits."

610.speaker: Player_Romus
610.text: "I love all Golcondists. And they love me."

611.speaker: Player_Romus
611.text: "Be not quick to judge your fellow man. Especially when he walks in the path of righteousness."

615.speaker: Player_Romus
615.text: "The Bludish Freedom Front? You mean the terrorist organization?"

619.speaker: Player_Romus
619.text: "We already have Derdian mercenaries fighting in Pales."

620.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
620.text: "Hardly. They are only trying to liberate their people from Sordish and Wehzek cruelty."

621.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
621.text: "Fighting other countries' wars helps them raise the funds to do so."

622.speaker: Lucita Azaro
622.text: "Additional Golcondist support would work wonders for their morale, I am sure."

623.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
623.text: "They make strange bedfellows. But useful ones."

625.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
625.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true

626.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
626.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

627.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
627.text: "That depends, Your Majesty. How flexible are you willing to be?"
627.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true

632.speaker: Player_Romus
632.text: "Actually, forget it. I refuse to budge."

637.speaker: Player_Romus
637.text: "You win. I will sell you the Monqiz port after all."

657.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
657.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_NerveGas"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_Trucks"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_Manpower"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_Requests_Tanks"] == false

658.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

662.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Rumburg_SellPortOfMonqiz"] == true)

666.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
666.text: "We will have to agree to disagree about the Bluds' righteousness. But they can be useful allies."

667.speaker: Player_Romus
667.text: "All right, then. Let's call in the Bludish cavalry."

669.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
669.text: "Thrilling. I'll have my people get in touch with their operatives posthaste."

670.text: "Nonetheless, this isn't what I had in mind. I kindly refuse the offer."

679.speaker: Player_Romus
679.text: "Your Majesty, what exactly is Rumburg's trouble with Sordland?"

680.speaker: Player_Romus
680.text: "In case you haven't forgotten, our investment in Sordish gas is benefiting both of our kingdoms."

684.speaker: Player_Romus
684.text: "I'm not a fan of the Sords either. Not after the trouble they've been giving you."

685.speaker: Player_Romus
685.text: "I cannot break my agreement with Wiktor Smolak. The fate of Zille hangs in the balance."
685.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

686.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
686.text: "Then you must decide. Zille or Pales?"

687.speaker: Player_Romus
687.text: "We are oppressing no one. We are merely executing counterterrorism measures."
687.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

689.speaker: Player_Romus
689.text: "I did not realize Rumburg and the BFF were that closely connected."
689.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

690.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
690.text: "Not officially, of course. You will find no paper trail."

691.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
691.text: "I know you yourself are at war. But it was cruel to let the Prince of Vendonesam's pleas for aid go unanswered."
691.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1)

698.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)

698.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

699.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
699.text: "At this stage, Your Majesty, the question isn't whether Rumburg will lend you aid. It's whether Rizia will remain a member of GRACE at all."

700.speaker: Narrator
700.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false)

704.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
704.text: "Before I can even think of lending you military aid, you must recommit to your relationship with Rumburg and GRACE."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "I don't care about my standing with GRACE."

706.speaker: Player_Romus
706.text: "Rizia is a founding member of GRACE. You cannot kick us out so easily."

710.speaker: Player_Romus
710.text: "What can I do to get back in your good graces? Pun intended."

711.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
711.text: "It is a simple majority vote, Your Majesty. And when it comes to Rumburg versus Rizia, you know which side the other monarchies will take."

712.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
712.text: "Well, you should. Without the support of other monarchies, Rizia will fall even if it wins Pales."

714.speaker: Player_Romus
714.text: "What can I do to get back in your good graces? No pun intended."

716.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
716.text: "No need to kiss my feet, dear. We are still family."

717.speaker: Player_Romus
717.text: "You are overreacting. We've always been on Rumburg's side."

718.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
718.text: "I will be the judge of that."

719.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
719.text: "I propose a deal. Our finest military aid package in exchange for the sale of your Port of Monqiz to Rumburg."

722.speaker: Lucita Azaro
722.text: "His Majesty is absolutely right. Granting any foreign country control over Monqiz would be a major security risk."

723.speaker: Player_Romus
723.text: "We'll sell you our largest port over my dead body."

724.speaker: Player_Romus
724.text: "Sure, why not? I don't see the harm in it."

725.speaker: Lucita Azaro
725.text: "What? Your Majesty, Monqiz is our most strategically vital shipping hub."

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "Granting your kingdom a foothold in the southern Antacean. I see."

727.speaker: Lucita Azaro
727.text: "Convenient for Rumburg. But a gigantic security risk for us."

728.speaker: Player_Romus
728.text: "I have some concerns about that proposal. To put it mildly."

729.speaker: Lucita Azaro
729.text: "As you should, Your Majesty. We can ill afford to lose another part of Rizia."

731.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
731.text: "Look at how shabby the port has become. With our technology, we can get it into marvelous shape in an instant."

735.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
735.text: "Your efforts to modernize the port have been admirable, but with our technology, we can maximize its efficiency even further."

736.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
736.text: "But Rumburg is not just any foreign country, are we?"

737.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
737.text: "Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grace. I foresee advantages for both of us."

738.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
738.text: "You wouldn't be losing Monqiz. You'd be sharing it."

739.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
739.text: "As you're shipping us a sizeable amount of energy through Monqiz, it's only logical to give us a say in how that shipping is run."

743.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
743.text: "And giving Rumburg a say in how shipping is run would only be logical should you begin sending us gas from the Aureus field."

744.speaker: Player_Romus
744.text: "I can see the sense of what you're saying. But I still think the disadvantages outweigh the benefits."

745.speaker: Player_Romus
745.text: "Such a cooperation would truly cement the alliance between our monarchies."

746.speaker: Player_Romus
746.text: "If we did this for you, we'd never owe you anything again."

750.speaker: Player_Romus
750.text: "We are trying to become less dependent on Rumburg. This will accomplish the opposite."

751.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
751.text: "Less dependent on everything but our military aid, you mean."

753.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
753.text: "No need for hyperbole. But it would be quite the grand gesture."

754.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
754.text: "Think what you will. You know I am right."

755.speaker: Lucita Azaro
755.text: "We do not need to resort to desperate measures to win the war, Your Majesty. We should not relinquish control of a critical asset for the sake of some artillery."

759.speaker: Lucita Azaro
759.text: "I admit winning the war may require drastic measures. But relinquishing control of this critical asset will leave us vulnerable in the future."

760.speaker: Player_Romus
760.text: "My war councilor is right. I will not sell the Port of Monqiz to Rumburg."

761.speaker: Player_Romus
761.text: "I know it's a risk, but victory will be worth it. Rumburg may purchase the port, Your Excellency." [+2 Budget, +2 Budget Per Turn]

763.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
763.text: "Brilliant. This will be our kingdoms' most fruitful collaboration yet."

765.speaker: Narrator
765.text: Lucita tried hard to hide her dismay.

767.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
767.text: "You are on your own in this war, then."

768.speaker: Lucita Azaro
768.text: "I sincerely hope your weaponry lives up to its reputation."

769.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
769.text: "Of course it will, Your Grace. I will arrange for a sizeable shipment of equipment to be sent to Rizia posthaste."

770.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
770.text: "That should be enough to mend our fences, don't you think?"

772.speaker: Player_Romus
772.text: "Not so fast. I think I deserve a little more than that."

773.speaker: Player_Romus
773.text: "I appreciate your generosity. However, our military needs go beyond basic equipment."

775.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

780.speaker: Lucita Azaro
780.text: "I respectfully disagree. For a concession of this magnitude, Rizia deserves much more."

784.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
784.text: "You drive a hard bargain, Your Grace."

785.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
785.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

788.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
788.text: "You will continue to receive the support of GRACE. That is enough of a reward."
788.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Allied"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Allied"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Neutral"] == true) == false)

790.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
790.text: "You drive a hard bargain, Your Majesty."

791.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
791.text: "I do still respect you, Your Majesty. But know that you are on thin ice. With me, and with the other monarchs of this world."

796.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
796.text: "Let's not beat around the bush, Your Majesty."

797.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
797.text: "If your goal is to lose Rumburg's support and get yourself booted out of GRACE, you've been doing a bang-up job of it."

798.speaker: Player_Romus
798.text: "Mistakes were made. Can you find it in your heart to forgive me?"

799.speaker: Player_Romus
799.text: "Rumburg helped carry Rizia through the tough years after the uprising. I am forever grateful for that. But I have begun to rethink our partnership."

800.speaker: Player_Romus
800.text: "You're bluffing, Your Excellency. You need Rizia as much as we need you."

801.speaker: Player_Romus
801.text: "Goal? I've been flying by the seat of my trousers since my father died."

806.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
806.text: "Come, now. You know that is not the case."

807.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
807.text: "Rethink? You are turning your back on Rumburg completely."

808.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
808.text: "I wish I could believe they were merely mistakes."

812.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
812.text: "It seems you did not take my advice regarding the treatment of Dastnurists in your country. I am warning you, Rumburg does not want a flood of religious asylum seekers at our borders."

816.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
816.text: "You ceded control of your kingdom's parliament to a bunch of scheming reformists..."
816.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true)

820.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
820.text: "Need I remind you of your broken energy promises to us?"

821.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
821.text: "What did you expect would happen when you undermined Rumburg by helping Wehlen in its senseless campaign against the Bluds?"
821.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true)

822.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
822.text: "What were you thinking when you took advantage of our embargo on Wehzek oil to begin importing it yourself?"
822.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true)

828.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
828.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

829.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
829.text: "Leaving the Prince of Vendonesam high and dry in his time of need... nobody truly invested in the future of monarchies would be so cruel."
829.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1)
