837.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
837.text: "You seem not to have taken my previous advice about Dastnurity. Believe me when I say Rumburg does not need hordes of Rizian Dastnurist asylum seekers streaming past our borders."
837.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true)

841.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
841.text: "You ceded control of your kingdom's parliament to a bunch of scheming reformists..."
841.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

846.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
846.text: "I have to ask. Do our blood ties mean nothing to you?"

850.speaker: Player_Romus
850.text: "Lena meant everything to me. But with her gone, I don't see why I should stay connected to Rumburg."

851.speaker: Player_Romus
851.text: "Your sister and I were forced into an unhappy marriage. What you call blood ties, I call shackles."

852.speaker: Player_Romus
852.text: "Don't be ridiculous, Beatrice. You're like the sister I never had. And I know how fond you are of Vina."

853.speaker: Player_Romus
853.text: "We will always be family, even if the alliance between our kingdoms is broken."

854.speaker: Player_Romus
854.text: "Please don't cut us off, Your Excellency. Innocent citizens will suffer."

855.speaker: Narrator
855.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Rumburg_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vendonesam_SupportLevel"] < 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true) == false)

856.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
856.text: "Fair points, Your Excellency. But Rizia is a founding member of GRACE. Threatening to drive us out entirely is--"

857.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
857.text: "I am not addressing you, Mr. Esquibel. I am speaking to my brother-in-law."

860.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
860.text: "So you don't see the economic benefits of staying in GRACE?"

864.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
864.text: "Or of our joint investment in the Sordish gas industry?"

867.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
867.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

868.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
868.text: "And what of our ability to help you pry Zille from the claws of the Wehzeks?"
868.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false)

870.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
870.text: "Be that as it may... you don't see the economic benefits of staying in GRACE?"

871.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
871.text: "Besides which... surely you see the economic benefits of staying in GRACE?"

872.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
872.text: "Your citizens are suffering as it is. We've played no part in that."

877.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
877.text: "Had there been no alliance, we would not be family."

878.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
878.text: "Hmm. I am glad you see the wisdom of staying in GRACE."

879.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
879.text: "But I am glad you see the wisdom of staying in GRACE."

880.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
880.text: "There is one thing you can do that will dramatically improve your standing with us. I warn you it is rather unorthodox."

881.speaker: Player_Romus
881.text: "We have other partnerships now. Rumburg simply isn't as important to us anymore."
881.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Valgsland_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_NegotiatingPower"] > 0)

885.speaker: Player_Romus
885.text: "If there's something you want from Rizia, please just spit it out."
885.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true)

886.speaker: Player_Romus
886.text: "I'll bite. How can you help us?"

887.speaker: Player_Romus
887.text: "We accepted your help already. Nothing came of it."

891.speaker: Player_Romus
891.text: "We didn't need your help before. And we don't need it now."

892.speaker: Player_Romus
892.text: "So what will it take to stay in your good graces? No pun intended."
892.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) == false)

896.speaker: Player_Romus
896.text: "So what will it take to stay in your good graces? Pun intended."
896.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true)

897.speaker: Player_Romus
897.text: "Rumburg has gone around making enemies with half of Merkopa. It does us no good to stay connected to you."
897.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true)

899.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
899.text: "Well, since you've mentioned it... I do have one suggestion. I warn you it is rather unorthodox."

900.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
900.text: "You could sell us your Port of Monqiz."

901.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
901.text: "His Majesty is being hyperbolic. But you must understand the risks inherent in such a sale, Your Excellency."

902.speaker: Player_Romus
902.text: "We'll sell you our largest port over my dead body."

903.speaker: Player_Romus
903.text: "Sure, why not? I don't see the harm in it."

904.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
904.text: "Your goodwill is beyond measure, Your Majesty. But you may want to consider the risks inherent in such a sele."

905.speaker: Player_Romus
905.text: "Granting your kingdom a foothold in the southern Antacean. I see."

906.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
906.text: "Yes, very geopolitically convenient for Rumburg. But I don't see commensurate benefits for Rizia."

907.speaker: Player_Romus
907.text: "I have some concerns about that proposal. To put it mildly."

908.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
908.text: "As you should, Your Majesty. Giving away another part of Rizia before Zille is returned would be most unwise."

909.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
909.text: "Risks? I see nothing but rewards for both of us."

910.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
910.text: "Look at how shabby the port has become. With our technology, we can get it into tip-top shape in an instant."

914.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
914.text: "Your efforts to modernize the port have been admirable, but with our technology, we can maximize its efficiency even further."

915.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
915.text: "Anything worth doing in life involves risk, Mr. Esquibel."

916.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
916.text: "Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grace. I foresee advantages for both of us."

917.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
917.text: "You wouldn't be giving Monqiz away. You'd be sharing it."

918.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
918.text: "As you're shipping us a sizeable amount of energy through Monqiz, it's only logical to give us a say in how that shipping is run."

922.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
922.text: "And given the volume of trade between Rizia and Rumburg, it does make sense to give us a say in how shipping is run."

923.speaker: Player_Romus
923.text: "That may be true. But I still have reservations."

924.speaker: Player_Romus
924.text: "Such a cooperation would truly cement the alliance between our monarchies."

925.speaker: Player_Romus
925.text: "If we did this for you, we'd never owe you anything again."

926.speaker: Player_Romus
926.text: "We are trying to become less dependent on Rumburg. This will accomplish the opposite."

931.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
931.text: "As would any king. Perhaps Mr. Esquibel can help you see past them."

932.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
932.text: "I agree it would be quite the grand gesture."

933.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
933.text: "We have certain contacts within Wehlen who could stir up trouble in Zille. Possibly enough to overthrow the government."

934.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
934.text: "I'm referring to a different kind of help."

936.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
936.text: "I assume you're referring to the Bludish Freedom Front. But how could they help Rizia. And why?"

937.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
937.text: "That is for us to discuss later. After you have recommitted to your partnership with Rumburg and GRACE."

938.speaker: Player_Romus
938.text: "All right, Your Excellency. How do I recommit?"

939.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
939.text: "What His Majesty means to say is--"

940.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
940.text: "I know perfectly well what His Majesty means to say."

943.speaker: Narrator
943.text: Our limousine screeched to a halt in the middle of the empty freeway. I heard the squeal of tires as the rest of the motorcade did the same.

944.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
944.text: "If you see no more value in our nations' partnership, then I see no more value in riding with you."

945.speaker: Narrator
945.text: The driver exited the vehicle and opened the passenger door for her.

946.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
946.text: "We shall go through the diplomatic formalities at the palace and put you on the first plane back tomorrow. Good day."

947.speaker: Player_Romus
947.text: "Wait. I want to stay in GRACE. Let's talk."

951.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
951.text: "I shall speak to our partners in GRACE posthaste. They're not going to be pleased with your attitude."

952.speaker: Narrator
952.text: She gathered her gown and left the car. I heard a door open and close as she got into the limousine carrying the rest of her family.

954.speaker: Narrator
954.text: She motioned to the driver to shut the door again. He returned to the car and we began moving again.

955.speaker: Player_Romus
955.text: "Forget it. That sounds like a spectacularly bad idea."

956.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
956.text: "You want me to forget it? Fine. I will."

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "I don't know about Zille, but I do care about our economic partnership. How do we restore that?"

958.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
958.text: "Don't think of it as dependence. Think of it as venturing into the future together."

960.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
960.text: "I am all for diplomacy, Your Majesty, but I urge you not to relinquish control over such a critical asset. Especially not while things are going so well with our neighbors."

964.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
964.text: "We have not outgrown the need for GRACE's protection. But I would still think twice before relinquishing control over such a critical asset."

965.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
965.text: "Were your security councilor here today, she would tell you the same thing. Using stronger language."

969.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
969.text: "Were any members of House Azaro here today, they would tell you the same thing. Using stronger language."

970.speaker: Player_Romus
970.text: "I agree with you -- and with House Azaro. Your Excellency, there is no way I can sell the port."

977.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
977.text: "I may have been exaggerating before. Rizia is not in such dire straits with Rumburg."

978.speaker: Narrator
978.text: Laurento breathed a sigh of relief.

979.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
979.text: "But I simply cannot abide by the terms of the agreement you made with Wehlen."

980.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
980.text: "Rumburg has been working hard to assist the Bludish Freedom Front in their struggle for liberation. It does us no good for you to be aiding in their oppression."

981.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
981.text: "But your continued ties to Sordland irk me to no end."
981.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)

984.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
984.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

985.speaker: Player_Romus
985.text: "Your Excellency, I assure you our partnership with Rumburg is more valuable to us than our foreign connections."

986.speaker: Player_Romus
986.text: "No, I'm not sure that I do."

987.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
987.text: "Then I kindly ask you to prove it."

988.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
988.text: "And furthermore, Rizia's continued ties to Sordland irk me to no end."

989.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
989.text: "Do you understand what I want from you, Your Majesty?"

991.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
991.text: "Break at least one of your agreements with Wehlen or Sordland, and your partnership with Rumburg and GRACE will continue as normal."
991.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)

994.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
994.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false

995.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
995.text: "Stop associating with the Sords, and your partnership with Rumburg and GRACE will continue as normal."
995.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)) == false)

999.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
999.text: "Promise to leave the Bluds alone, and your partnership with Rumburg and GRACE will continue as normal."
999.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)) == false)

1000.speaker: Player_Romus
1000.text: "Absolutely not. I am a king of my word, and I stick to my agreements."

1001.speaker: Player_Romus
1001.text: "I will not. The heretic Golcondists do not deserve my mercy."

1003.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1003.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)

1004.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1004.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true)) == false

1006.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1006.text: "Circumstances change, Your Majesty. A wise monarch is flexible."

1012.speaker: Player_Romus
1012.text: "I will break off the bonds Rizia purchased from Sordland."

1013.speaker: Player_Romus
1013.text: "Actually, never mind. I refuse to budge."

1014.speaker: Player_Romus
1014.text: "I will allow the Bludish people into Rizia once more."

1015.speaker: Player_Romus
1015.text: "I will cease Rizia's participation in Operation Bear Trap."

1016.speaker: Player_Romus
1016.text: "I will end Rizia's trade deal with Sordland."

1026.speaker: Player_Romus
1026.text: "I will nationalize the Sordish resort in Valenqiris."

1028.speaker: Player_Romus
1028.text: "I do. But I've worked hard to cultivate our international partnerships. I will not break them just to appease you."

1032.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1032.text: "I understand the need to remain invested in Gasom. But outside of that, I don't see why you should be doing the Sords any favors."

1037.speaker: Narrator
1037.text: The Queen nodded with some satisfaction.

1039.speaker: Player_Romus
1039.text: "In case you haven't forgotten, our investment in Sordish gas is benefiting both of our kingdoms."

1040.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1040.text: "You may consider yourself out of the danger zone as far as GRACE is concerned."

1045.speaker: Player_Romus
1045.text: "All right. Here's what I am willing to do."

1046.speaker: Player_Romus
1046.text: "Is there nothing else our kingdom can do for you instead?"

1047.speaker: Player_Romus
1047.text: "I'm not a fan of the Sords either. Not after the trouble they've been giving you."

1048.speaker: Player_Romus
1048.text: "I cannot break my agreement with Wiktor Smolak. The fate of Zille hangs in the balance."
1048.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

1051.speaker: Player_Romus
1051.text: "Your Majesty, what exactly is Rumburg's trouble with Sordland?"

1052.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1052.text: "If you reclaim Zille but have nobody to sell its gold to, it's as good as useless."

1053.speaker: Player_Romus
1053.text: "We are oppressing no one. We are merely executing counterterrorism measures."
1053.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

1054.speaker: Player_Romus
1054.text: "I did not realize Rumburg and the BFF were that closely connected."
1054.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

1056.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1056.text: "Not officially, of course. You will find no paper trail."

1059.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1059.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

1062.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1062.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

1063.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1063.text: "I do have one other suggestion. But I warn you it is rather unorthodox."

1068.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1068.text: "In fact... I have a business opportunity of sorts for your government. Accept it, and you won't have to worry about your standing with us or GRACE for a good long while."
1068.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false)

1069.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1069.text: "I suggest that you assist Rumburg in funding the Bludish Freedom Front."

1075.speaker: Player_Romus
1075.text: "That's it? Of course I welcome the opportunity to assist devout Wruhecists in need."

1076.speaker: Player_Romus
1076.text: "Hmm. Is that how you help us get Zille back, then?"

1081.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1081.text: "As loathe as I am to suggest violence as a solution to the Zille conundrum...  an internal resistance effort from the BFF could work in perfect concert with the Derdian mercenaries already present in the region."

1082.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1082.text: "I am still loathe to suggest violence as a solution to the Zille conundrum. But in the absence of an agreement with President Smolak, an internal resistance might be our last hope."

1086.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1086.text: "I am loathe to suggest violence as a solution to the Zille conundrum. Especially since Wehlen may yet return the region through diplomatic means."

1087.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1087.text: "They are a persecuted minority fighting an oppressive government."

1088.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1088.text: "And they, in turn, can assist you in the reclamation of Zille."

1089.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1089.text: "And their struggle can, conveniently, be channeled towards Zille."

1091.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1091.text: "Try to see past their religion and empathize with their struggle against the Wehzek government."

1092.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1092.text: "A struggle that can, conveniently, be channeled towards Zille."

1093.speaker: Player_Romus
1093.text: "I don't want the BFF getting in the way of our existing resistance plans."

1097.speaker: Player_Romus
1097.text: "The BFF would be active in Zille sooner or later, anyway. We'd just be giving them a nudge."

1098.speaker: Player_Romus
1098.text: "The BFF have their own fight going on. I don't want to interfere with it one way or another."

1099.speaker: Player_Romus
1099.text: "If we funded the BFF and Smolak found out about it, he'd have an excuse to hold on to Zille forever."

1100.speaker: Player_Romus
1100.text: "Why do I get the feeling you're trying to use both Rizia and the BFF toward your own ends, Your Excellency?"

1101.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1101.text: "Don't be so cynical. I am giving you a final chance to prove that your interests still align with ours."

1102.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1102.text: "And who would tell him? Do you run that leaky of a ship, Your Majesty?"

1104.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1104.text: "That makes sense. But a monetary contribution towards their struggle would nonetheless be greatly appreciated."

1105.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1105.text: "I am giving you a final chance to prove that your interests align with ours. You may take it or leave it."

1107.speaker: Player_Romus
1107.text: "Good thing it's just us then, isn't it? I agree to sell the Port of Monqiz to Rumburg." [+2 Budget, +2 Budget Per Turn]

1110.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1110.text: "You may consider your status with GRACE restored. And then some."

1113.speaker: Player_Romus
1113.text: "However, I'm willing to revisit your other request."

1119.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1119.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_SordlandWehlenDemandsMade"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_DiscussedBFFFunding"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0)) == false

1120.speaker: Player_Romus
1120.text: "I'm not going to do anything else for Rumburg, either. I don't care about the consequences."

1121.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1121.text: "I am afraid I see no other way for Rizia to redeem itself."
1121.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_SordlandWehlenDemandsMade"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn07_Rumburg_DiscussedBFFFunding"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] > 0)) == false

1124.speaker: Narrator
1124.text: Laurento tried to hide his dismay.

1125.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1125.text: "A new landmark for Rizian-Rumburgian relations, no doubt about it. Her Highness Princess Lena would be proud."

1130.speaker: Player_Romus
1130.text: "I will help Rumburg fund the Bludish Freedom Front. But I will not accept their assistance in Zille."

1131.speaker: Player_Romus
1131.text: "I'll co-fund the Bludish Freedom Front along with Rumburg, but I fully expect them to be of assistance in Zille."

1136.speaker: Player_Romus
1136.text: "No... I don't like this. Is there something else I can do for Rumburg instead?"

1137.speaker: Player_Romus
1137.text: "My final answer is no. I'll be damned to hell before I help Golcondist sinners spread their twisted gospel."

1138.speaker: Player_Romus
1138.text: "I'd love to agree to this. But I don't have the budget for it."

1142.speaker: Player_Romus
1142.text: "You don't have to twist my arm, Your Excellency. I'll fund the Bludish Freedom Front, if you can promise me they'll help us 'liberate' Zille."

1147.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1147.text: "I knew you were taking Rizia in a more religious direction, but to hear such zealotry with my own ears..."

1148.speaker: Player_Romus
1148.text: "I'll go in on funding the BFF. But tell your contacts there to stick to northern Wehlen."

1149.speaker: Player_Romus
1149.text: "Zealotry? I am telling the objective truth. If you could only look beyond the narrow worldview of St. Dast, you'd understand."

1150.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1150.text: "Up to this point, we have been aiding the Bluds' liberation efforts in the north of Wehlen. But I see no reason why their struggle can't be directed southward as well."

1151.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1151.text: "If I may, Your Excellency... Zille has nothing to do with the former Greater Bludia region. Why would the BFF get involved there?"

1155.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1155.text: "You have established Rizia as a safe haven for their so-called religion. Besides which..."

1156.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1156.text: "You have shown yourself to be no great friend to Wiktor Smolak. Besides which..."

1160.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1160.text: "Any action that destabilizes the Smolak regime will help the Bludish cause, no matter where it is carried out."

1161.speaker: Narrator
1161.text: Laurento pondered over this for a moment.

1162.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1162.text: "I'm going to have to have a long chat with our fellow GRACE members regarding your membership status."

1165.speaker: Player_Romus
1165.text: "You should consider the same, Your Excellency. Your secularization reforms will lead Rumburg to ruin."

1166.speaker: Player_Romus
1166.text: "It is not too late for you to embrace Wruhecism either, Beatrice. Your sister was so happy after she saw the light."

1170.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1170.text: "My sister despised your silly religion almost as much as she despised you."

1171.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1171.text: "My sister was happy with you. Wruhecism had nothing to do with it."

1173.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1173.text: "The King does not wish to support the Bludish Freedom Front, Your Excellency. Perhaps it's best to leave it at that."

1174.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1174.text: "As valuable as religion is to me personally, it must be separated from the state if my nation is to be taken seriously. I'm surprised Mr. Esquibel hasn't told you the same."

1176.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1176.text: "Rizia's religious governance is between the King and our Grand Wiseman. I wouldn't presume to have a say in such matters."

1178.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1178.text: "The King does not wish to support the Bludish Freedom Front. No need to bring personal grievances into this conversation."

1179.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1179.text: "The King does not wish to support the Bludish Freedom Front. Perhaps it's best to leave it at that."

1180.speaker: Narrator
1180.text: Once we were in motion, Beatrice smiled at the two of us.
1180.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == true) == false)

1181.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1181.text: "Well. Look at us. Still allies after all these years."

1185.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1185.text: "My energy ministers tell me that our deal is going swimmingly."

1189.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1189.text: "The Rumburgian expatriate community couldn't be happier with Rizia's recent religious reforms."

1190.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1190.text: "Your business-friendly policies have helped both of our nations greatly."

1197.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1197.text: "Then I suppose I have Mr. Esquibel to thank for Rizia's skillful de-escalation of the Pales situation."

1202.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1202.text: "But it was His Majesty who ferreted out the traitor in our midst."

1203.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1203.text: "But it was His Majesty's quick thinking that helped us avoid an armed conflict."

1204.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1204.text: "Ah, yes. What an unfortunate turn of events."

1205.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1205.text: "I had hoped to meet this Duchess Azaro someday. It's rare to see a noblewoman who's also a capable military officer."

1207.speaker: Player_Romus
1207.text: "Too good to be true, as it turned out."

1208.speaker: Player_Romus
1208.text: "Her father is just as capable, if not more so."

1209.speaker: Player_Romus
1209.text: "She can't be that capable if she let herself get found out."

1215.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1215.text: "As long as his warmongering days are over."

1217.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1217.text: "Well done. And gaining access to the Aureus gas field at the same time -- what a feat."

1218.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1218.text: "Well done. Though it's a pity you lost access to the Aureus gas field after all that."

1219.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1219.text: "In any event, well done. And managing to keep your access to the Aureus field -- what a feat."

1223.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1223.text: "In any event, well done. Though it's a pity you lost access to the Aureus field."

1227.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1227.text: "Of course I'm pleased that you managed to gain access to the Aureus field while avoiding conflict with Pales."
1227.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true)

1228.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1228.text: "I admit I was somewhat disappointed when Rizia lost access to the Aureus gas field."
1228.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == true) == false)

1232.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1232.text: "We still have our energy partnership with Sordland to fall back on."

1237.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1237.text: "I know it's not smooth sailing for any of us monarchies. But I trust you know what you're doing."

1238.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1238.text: "The recent turmoil in Iza gave me pause. But I trust you know what you're doing."

1242.speaker: Player_Romus
1242.text: "Not at all. I've been flying by the seat of my trousers since Father died."

1246.speaker: Player_Romus
1246.text: "Whenever the path before me is unclear, I ask the Lord to show me the way."

1247.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1247.text: "I see. Rather antiquated, but if it works..."

1249.speaker: Player_Romus
1249.text: "Iza is totally under control. Just had to take care of a few unsavory elements."

1250.speaker: Player_Romus
1250.text: "Oh, I do. But my vision for a transformed Rizia is far from complete."

1251.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1251.text: "Such as your own cousin... Well. It did seem like he deserved it."

1252.speaker: Player_Romus
1252.text: "As long as we have Rumburg's continued support, we shall not falter."

1256.speaker: Player_Romus
1256.text: "I do. It won't be long before our Golden Kingdom is restored once more."

1261.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1261.text: "I suppose I have the Lord to thank for Rizia's skillful de-escalation of the Pales situation. Or was that Mr. Esquibel?"

1265.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1265.text: "Don't change too much too swiftly. You have many years left to reign."

1266.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1266.text: "I am sure it will be. You have many years left to reign."

1267.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1267.text: "I must compliment you on your skillful de-escalation of the Pales situation. Unless, of course, that was Mr. Esquibel?"

1271.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1271.text: "Between that and our energy partnership with Sordland, we will be able to continue our gas trade with Rumburg for years to come."

1272.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1272.text: "Yes, as long as relations with Pales stay friendly, we'll have the means to fulfill our energy commitments for years to come."

1273.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1273.text: "Excellent. We wouldn't want to have to go begging to Sordland, now, would we?"

1274.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1274.text: "We have other energy sources to fall back on. Or so Ms. Werner tells us."

1275.speaker: Narrator
1275.text: Our car began moving again. Laurento and I looked at each other.

1278.speaker: Player_Romus
1278.text: "Perhaps I could've handled that more diplomatically."

1279.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1279.text: "I'm not going to lie. It will be a real blow to Rizia if Rumburg cuts us off."

1284.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1284.text: "The prospect of Rumburg cutting us off would've struck fear into your father's heart. But you're made of stronger stuff."

1285.speaker: Narrator
1285.text: Laurento shifted in his seat uneasily.

1286.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1286.text: "We'll lose some trade income. But if we continue strengthening our connections with our neighbors, we can afford to break our alliance."

1287.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1287.text: "We're not in good standing with any of our neighbors. And to lose the support of our most powerful ally..."

1291.speaker: Player_Romus
1291.text: "Do not worry. God will provide for us, as He always has."

1292.speaker: Player_Romus
1292.text: "Message received. Once we reach the palace, I'll get to groveling."

1293.speaker: Player_Romus
1293.text: "Rumburg was never our ally. More like our suzerain."

1295.speaker: Player_Romus
1295.text: "Beatrice will never completely cut us off. Not if she still wants to see Vina."

1296.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1296.text: "I will try to have faith, Your Majesty."

1297.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1297.text: "It may be too late. The Queen is very good at holding grudges."

1298.speaker: Player_Romus
1298.text: "You've seen how Rumburg has been acting with Sordland. We need to get away from them before they make us look bad."

1299.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1299.text: "I do hope they're stable. I wouldn't want to have to go begging to Sordland in the case of an energy crisis."

1300.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1300.text: "I have not yet broached the subject of Zille."

1301.speaker: Narrator
1301.text: We rode on. I looked out the window at a completely empty freeway.

1302.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1302.text: "If Vina keeps associating with anti-monarchists, her aunt may not want to see her."

1306.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1306.text: "Some things are stronger than familial love, Your Majesty."

1307.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1307.text: "You're absolutely right. If only we could substitute GRACE with our own regional trade pact..."

1308.speaker: Player_Romus
1308.text: "We may soon be too democratic for GRACE, anyway."

1312.speaker: Player_Romus
1312.text: "The other monarchies in GRACE are too weak, anyway."

1313.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1313.text: "But not for our neighbors. If only we could substitute GRACE with our own regional trade pact..."

1314.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1314.text: "It is a very unbalanced organization, isn't it? If only we could substitute GRACE with our own regional trade pact..."

1315.speaker: Narrator
1315.text: We turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

1316.speaker: Narrator
1316.text: We were in for an awkward stay. I could hardly wait to return home.

1319.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1319.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

1320.speaker: Narrator
1320.text: None of us spoke as we turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

1321.speaker: Narrator
1321.text: Laurento smiled, but I could still see concern around the corners of his eyes.

1322.speaker: Player_Romus
1322.text: "I hope you make it worth our while, Your Excellency."

1324.speaker: Player_Romus
1324.text: "All right. Now let's talk about how you can help us win Zille back."
1324.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

1327.speaker: Player_Romus
1327.text: "I didn't just make a terrible mistake, did I?"

1329.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1329.text: "Remember, Your Majesty. Without Rumburg, the Golden Kingdom would turn to dust."

1330.speaker: Narrator
1330.text: We turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

1331.speaker: Narrator
1331.text: We finished the journey in comfortable silence. There was still a long visit ahead of us.

1332.speaker: Player_Romus
1332.text: "What is there to broach? I didn't need Rumburg's help with Zille before, and I don't need it now."

1339.speaker: Player_Romus
1339.text: "Right. Your oil embargo helped us get a very favorable deal with Wehlen. I thank you for it."

1340.speaker: Player_Romus
1340.text: "Right. It's unfortunate that we were unable to come to an agreement with Wehlen, despite the pressure from your oil embargo."

1341.speaker: Player_Romus
1341.text: "We should be getting the region back soon. Assuming we stick to the terms of my agreement with Wiktor Smolak."

1345.speaker: Player_Romus
1345.text: "We have resistance forces in place there, but I'm worried they won't be enough."

1346.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1346.text: "Are you sure? Because I have another opportunity for you."

1347.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1347.text: "Indeed. But I have another opportunity for you."

1348.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1348.text: "In case that deal doesn't work out... I have another opportunity for you."

1350.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1350.text: "Now. Is anything else on your mind?"

1354.speaker: Player_Romus
1354.text: "We are a founding member of GRACE. The others would never vote us out."

1356.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1356.text: "It's a dangerous road you are traveling, Your Majesty. Rumburg cannot accompany you on it."

1358.speaker: Player_Romus
1358.text: "Rizia has other allies now. We don't need you. Isn't that true, Mr. Esquibel?"

1359.speaker: Player_Romus
1359.text: "I hope that our kingdoms can still maintain a civil relationship."

1360.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1360.text: "That is up to you, Your Majesty."

1364.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1364.text: "Well, yes, we are in the process of forming closer bonds with our neighbors. Though we still lack an international economic pact that is equivalent to GRACE."

1368.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1368.text: "As long as my niece remains heir to the Rizian throne... then yes. We are still family."

1372.speaker: Player_Romus
1372.text: "Cut us off if you wish. We have other partnerships now."

1376.speaker: Player_Romus
1376.text: "The age of monarchies is long past, anyway. It is time for Rizia to evolve."

1377.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1377.text: "Good luck doing so while mired in war."

1378.speaker: Player_Romus
1378.text: "I still treasure our familial bond, Your Excellency. I hope you do as well."

1379.speaker: Narrator
1379.text: She gave me a guarded look.

1380.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1380.text: "As long as my niece is still heir to the Rizian throne, then yes, we are still family."

1384.speaker: Player_Romus
1384.text: "It makes no difference, Your Excellency. God is with us."

1388.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1388.text: "We shall see who needs whom more."

1389.speaker: Narrator
1389.text: She looked at me with a mixture of fear and pity.

1391.speaker: Narrator
1391.text: Lucita gave me a look of warning. Beatrice instantly clocked it.

1392.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1392.text: "Hmm. May your new partners protect your troops, then."

1393.speaker: Narrator
1393.text: Lucita gave a tight nod of confirmation.

1394.speaker: Narrator
1394.text: None of us spoke as we turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

1395.speaker: Player_Romus
1395.text: "Only what your talented chefs will be serving us for supper tonight."

1399.speaker: Player_Romus
1399.text: "What happens if your tensions with Sordland escalate? Do you expect Rizia to fight for you?"

1400.speaker: Player_Romus
1400.text: "How important is it to you that Rizia stay a member of GRACE?"

1401.speaker: Player_Romus
1401.text: "If I told you I had moved on from Lena, would it bother you?"

1405.speaker: Narrator
1405.text: Lucita shifted in her seat nervously. The Queen's eyes darted between the two of us again.

1410.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1410.text: "It's been over 10 years, my dear. I would be concerned if you hadn't moved on."

1411.speaker: Narrator
1411.text: Both Lucita and the Queen gave me curious looks.

1415.speaker: Narrator
1415.text: The Queen fixed me with a long stare.

1416.speaker: Narrator
1416.text: Both Laurento and the Queen gave me curious looks.

1417.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1417.text: "Fret not. As long as my niece is still heir apparent to the Rizian throne, you will always be family in my eyes."

1419.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1419.text: "That's the spirit. Have you ever had caviar from the Tranquil Sea? I'll be so bold as to declare that it gives the Lespians a run for their money."

1421.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1421.text: "My dear... no nation is an island."

1422.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1422.text: "You may be drawing closer to your neighbors, but do they understand the unique pressures a monarch is under? Will they offer you economic protection in times of hardship?"

1426.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1426.text: "We are facing isolation from our neighbors and pressure from an increasingly democratized world. We need each other more than ever."

1428.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1428.text: "First off, there will be no escalation. Not if President Rayne knows what is good for him."

1429.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1429.text: "Second, Rumburg has enough reservists to fight for a century if we need to. Calling in our distant neighbors would be a waste of ship fuel."

1433.speaker: Narrator
1433.text: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Lucita nod in agreement.

1434.speaker: Narrator
1434.text: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Laurento nod in agreement.

1435.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1435.text: "But of course, I would expect you to support the cause. As I am doing for you."

1439.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1439.text: "But of course, I would expect you to support the cause in whatever way you could."

1440.speaker: Player_Romus
1440.text: "Should that day ever come, Rizia will be there for you."

1441.speaker: Player_Romus
1441.text: "Getting caught between trading partners would be most uncomfortable. But you know where my allegiances lie."

1444.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1444.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

1445.speaker: Player_Romus
1445.text: "I feel the same way about the Sords as you do. You do not have to doubt my allegiance."
1445.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Sordland_BondPurchase"] == true) == false

1450.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1450.text: "No nation is an island, my dear. Especially not a kingdom."

1451.speaker: Player_Romus
1451.text: "I was only asking a hypothetical question."

1452.speaker: Player_Romus
1452.text: "I agree completely. GRACE is integral to our survival as kingdoms."

1454.speaker: Player_Romus
1454.text: "And if I want to become part of that democratized world?"

1459.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1459.text: "May you never have to put that theory to the test."

1461.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1461.text: "I do hope you're satisfied with the answer."

1462.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1462.text: "I'm terribly glad we are on the same page."

1463.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1463.text: "I suggest you first think long and hard about the consequences."

1466.speaker: Narrator
1466.text: She looked at me in surprise.

1470.speaker: Player_Romus
1470.text: "My new security councilor is just as capable. If not more so."

1471.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1471.text: "Ah, yes. The commoner. One cannot help but admire a man of such brute strength."

1475.speaker: Player_Romus
1475.text: "By the way. How would you feel about the Grand Duchy of Pales joining GRACE?"

1477.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1477.text: "Oh, just fine. A little rebellion here and there, but nothing to worry about."

1479.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1479.text: "Why, I'm always happy to add more members to our exclusive club."

1483.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1483.text: "Especially ones with such prodigious natural gas reserves."

1484.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1484.text: "As long as they are not too closely enmeshed with ATO, that is."

1485.speaker: Player_Romus
1485.text: "I can sway the Duke away from Lespia. I am confident of it."

1486.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1486.text: "I've had the entire freeway cleared of traffic, of course. Rumburg spares no expense for visiting allies."

1487.speaker: Player_Romus
1487.text: "If Rumburg can get good gas prices out of the bargain, does it matter?"

1488.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1488.text: "A very intriguing proposition. You must let me know how it goes."

1490.speaker: Player_Romus
1490.text: "I have a plan. Don't forget that Vina is still single."

1491.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1491.text: "Oh, my. Uniting Rumburg, Pales and Rizia under one family crest would be an exciting feat indeed."

1495.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1495.text: "Sordland has trouble with us, dear Romus. Not the other way around."

1496.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1496.text: "Sordland has trouble with us, dear Romus. Not the other way around."

1497.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1497.text: "Sordland has trouble with us, Mr. Esquibel. Not the other way around."

1501.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1501.text: "Though I must say Rizia is barely any better in that regard."

1502.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1502.text: "And put an embargo on us as part of his silly little 'emergency'."

1506.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1506.text: "His decision to aid Wehlen in the slaughter of the poor, beleaguered Bluds... despicable."

1512.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1512.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_AcceptedSordlandBondTalkOffer"] == true) == false

1513.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1513.text: "Frankly, Your Majesty, the fact that Rizia is maintaining its connections to Sordland amounts to a betrayal in my eyes."
1513.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_JointOperation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_AcceptedSordlandBondTalkOffer"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false)

1514.speaker: Player_Romus
1514.text: "I'm not a fan of President Rayne, either. But I've got to honor the deals I made with his predecessor."

1515.speaker: Player_Romus
1515.text: "Call me crazy, but I trust Rayne. There's just something about him."

1516.speaker: Player_Romus
1516.text: "Yes, I haven't liked President Rayne since his dealings with Gasom. Alphonso had the stage set for us to invest, then Rayne tore it all down."

1517.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1517.text: "That alone is proof that Sordland can no longer be trusted. If it ever could."

1521.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1521.text: "And then their President Rayne had the nerve to retaliate by shutting down the Sordish Consulate in Dome..."

1522.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1522.text: "And then their President Rayne had the nerve to condemn us..."

1526.speaker: Narrator
1526.text: Lucita looked bemused. She nodded at Beatrice to continue.

1527.speaker: Narrator
1527.text: Laurento looked distressed. He nodded at Beatrice to continue.

1531.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1531.text: "I do see potential in your gas deal with them. But even there, you must tread carefully."
1531.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_JointOperation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true)

1532.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1532.text: "I'm happy you weren't foolish enough to accept any of their offers. One shouldn't get into bed with a country like that."
1532.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_JointOperation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_Terrorism_AntiBFF"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_AcceptedSordlandBondTalkOffer"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomHighOutput"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Sordland_GasomAverageOutput"] == true) == false)

1533.speaker: Player_Romus
1533.text: "It's mutual, isn't it? The Sords turned down *our* opportunity to invest in Gasom."

1534.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1534.text: "Indeed. Proof of their renewed prejudice against monarchies."

1535.speaker: Player_Romus
1535.text: "The Gasom deal has been lucrative for us both. We must be careful not to bite the hand that feeds us."

1536.speaker: Player_Romus
1536.text: "I'm not sure. We could have used the extra income."

1537.speaker: Player_Romus
1537.text: "Your sister would've wanted it that way."

1539.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1539.text: "Believe me, it would not have been worth it."

1540.speaker: Player_Romus
1540.text: "This is Rumburg's vendetta. It doesn't concern my kingdom at all."

1544.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1544.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_AcceptedSordlandBondTalkOffer"] == true) == false

1545.speaker: Player_Romus
1545.text: "We have no other ties. The Gasom deal is just cold, hard business."
1545.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Sordland"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_Sordland_ResortDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn04_AcceptedSordlandBondTalkOffer"] == true) == false

1546.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1546.text: "They may not be feeding us for long. You know that Rayne is facing pressure from his party to shut foreign investors out of Sordish energy companies."

1547.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1547.text: "It might not last long, by the way. You know that Rayne is facing pressure from his party to shut foreign investors out of Sordish energy companies."

1548.speaker: Narrator
1548.text: She forced herself to take a deep breath.

1552.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1552.text: "Have Rayne's Malenyevist leanings not escaped your notice?"

1556.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1556.text: "Have Rayne's Sollist leanings not escaped your notice?"

1560.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1560.text: "And we are not even receiving particularly high returns."

1561.speaker: Player_Romus
1561.text: "Plenty of countries judge us for being in bed with Rumburg."

1563.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1563.text: "If you don't like the bed, you ought to get out of it."

1564.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1564.text: "I respect that you are a man of your word. But I fear that the Sordish president is not."

1565.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1565.text: "He will stab both of our kingdoms in the back with no hesitation. Mark my words."

1569.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1569.text: "It may not appear so at the moment, but Rayne is most certainly up to something."
1569.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Malenyevist"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Sollist"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Democratic"] > 5  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

1570.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1570.text: "Have Rayne's pro-Arcasian leanings not escaped your notice?"
1570.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Malenyevist"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Sollist"] > 5) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Democratic"] > 5  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

1571.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1571.text: "Good luck winning your war once Sordland joins ATO, Your Majesty."

1575.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1575.text: "We'll show them who's in the right."

1576.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1576.text: "I can only hope that the Sords refrain from further provocation. Nobody wants another conflict in Merkopa."

1580.speaker: Narrator
1580.text: She calmly poured herself a glass of sparkling water from the limousine's minibar.

1581.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1581.text: "I can only hope that the Sords refrain from further provocation. The last thing anyone wants is conflict."

1582.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1582.text: "It's true we closed our embassy in Lachaven. But that was a long-overdue response to the Republic's many attempts to isolate us."

1597.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
1597.text: "I understand you've been having some trouble with the republic lately?"

1626.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1626.text: "The Rumburgian expatriate community couldn't be happier with Rizia's treatment of Dastnurists."
1626.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Happy"] == true)

1630.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
1630.text: "I wish you'd taken my advice about the Dastnurist community to heart. I hear Rumburg expatriates feel their freedom of religion is restricted."
1630.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Rumburg"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Happy"] == true) == false)
